events.title: Become a Mini Painting Maestro by Mastering the Fundamentals
events.shortDescription: Have you ever felt that your painting has hit a plateau and you just can’t push to that next level? The culprit is most likely the criminally undertaught skills of paint consistency and brush control.
events.longDescription: What is the single most important skill in Mini-Painting; Color Theory? OSL? NMM? Buttery Smooth Blending? All those sound great, but are impossible to pull off without knowing how to use your paints and brushes to their fullest potential. In this class we will take a deep dive into the different levels of paint dilution, how they behave differently from each other, and when to use them. In addition, we will talk about how to load (and unload) your brush for maximum precision. From base coating to glazing to freehand, the skills you will learn in this class will take your painting to new heights. While this course is mainly aimed at beginner and intermediate painters, advanced painters are welcome too if they want an in-depth refresher.

events.title: Become the Chef: the Beginner's Guide to Miniature Paints
events.shortDescription: Much like how good chefs know their ingredients to flavor their dish, a good minipainter knows their paints to flavor their model. Here we will learn what's in the paint, and how to use it!
events.longDescription: Knowing what you're painting with is just as important as knowing what you want to paint. In this course, each person will be given a cube on which we will test multiple types of paints such as: branded miniature paints, metallic paints, heavy body acrylics, airbrush paints, inks, and fluorescents. All tools and paints will be provided. However, feel free to bring anything you would like to learn with, but please do not eat the paint!

events.title: Lose the Fear of Green Stuff

events.longDescription: This sculpting class will be taught by Joe Orteza, a 14-time Golden Demon winner and professional art teacher. Students will learn how to sculpt elements such as capes, banners, and relief details that bring more movement and individuality to their miniatures. All materials will be provided. Each attendee will receive green stuff to use during the session and will also take home a big sculpting kit included with the course fee, allowing them to continue practicing their new skills after the class!

events.title: Upgrade Your FDM Prints
events.shortDescription: Upgrade basic FDM prints with fast surface treatments. Learn sanding, fillers, carving, and texture tricks to hide layer lines and create believable stone, wood, and metal finishes.
events.longDescription: Learn how to turn basic FDM prints into convincing tabletop terrain using fast, practical surface treatments. This hands-on workshop covers sanding, fillers, carving, and texture techniques that hide layer lines while creating believable stone, wood, metal, and concrete finishes that read clearly at gaming distance.  Participants will work on sample prints while learning how to choose the right treatment for different materials, add scale-appropriate detail, and avoid common mistakes that waste time or muddy forms. The focus is on repeatable methods you can use on terrain, scatter pieces, and props printed at home—no advanced painting skills or specialized tools required.  Perfect for terrain builders, RPG dungeon masters, and hobbyists who want better-looking results from everyday printers.

events.title: Sketch Style: Speed Painting for Gaming & Beyond
events.shortDescription: Achieve bold, expressive painting in a minimum amount of time! This style is a great way to visualize lighting. Join Matt DiPietro as he paints a model from start to finish in an hour.

events.title: Invitation to the Ball: A History of Ballroom Dance & Culture

events.title: Space Combat in Movies, Books and Games
events.shortDescription: Movies usually get things wrong when depicting space combat. Realistic ship movement, zero-G hand-to-hand combat, & unique aspects of space warfare for writers & game devs. Izaac Falken, NSDM staff.
events.longDescription: Movies and novels often get things wrong when depicting combat in space. Zero-G & vacuum conditions produce effects that run contrary to human instincts & experiences, including those of the potential audience. This seminar examines how to write & simulate realistic space combat for storywriters & game developers. We’ll discuss the complexities of vessel movement in zero-gravity environments, where traditional concepts of speed & maneuverability are fundamentally different. Hand-to-hand combat in low-G & vacuum conditions will also be explored, highlighting unique challenges & outcomes. The session will cover both the benefits & pitfalls of incorporating these realistic elements into narratives, helping to create more immersive & believable space warfare scenarios. Presented by Izaac Falken, on the National Security Decision Making Game staff.

events.title: Politics and Procurement, 1903: The Ross Rifle
events.shortDescription: Canadian Army needs a new rifle. They made the Ross. Many problems, some fixed but some not, it saw service into WW I. What drove their persistence with a questionable weapon? Mike Tucker, NSDM staff
events.longDescription: The Second Boer War highlighted a requirement for a "modern" (by 1902 standards) infantry weapon for the Canadian Army. But Britain refused to license the Lee-Enfield for production in Canada. So the newly-designed, all-Canadian Ross rifle went into production to supply the Canadian Army. A series of problems, corrections, accusations and counteraccusations ensued over the next 12 years, well into World War I until Canadian units were often reequipped with the Lee-Enfield. The Ross rifles were withdrawn to training units in the Canada, the UK and the US, to free up more Lee-Enfields and Springfields for combat deployment. Lecture will focus on the politics and the production of this rifle and their impact on World War I and on Canadian military history. Presented by Mike Tucker of the National Security Decision Making Game staff.

events.longDescription: Would you like a soft, fuzzy creature to sit next to you while gaming?  Join us for a fun and creative class where you will learn to craft your very own unique worry pet using yarn and a pompom making tool (which you keep).  You will be guided step-by-step on how to use the pompom making tool to make a large pompom using colorful yarn. You then add eyes and feet to create your Worry Pet.  Some manual dexterity is required to wrap the yarn on the pompom making tool, cut the yarn and shape the pompom. We provide lots of hands-on training and help.  You will leave with a completed Worry Pet along with written instructions and pompom making tool (yours to keep) to use at home.  All materials are provided, just bring your imagination.  See the Photos on our Facebook page for examples: https://www.facebook.com/HeartoftheHeroCrafts/photos

events.title: Collaborative Play, Collaborative Work: Using D&D and Personality Theory to Enhance Teamwork
events.shortDescription: Using D&D and Myers-Briggs theory, this seminar examines how collaborative play reveals insights into teamwork, communication, and group cohesion across professional and educational settings.
events.longDescription: This seminar reports on findings from a study using D&D to examine team dynamics, personality, and collaboration. Small teams of four to five participants were assessed using Myers-Briggs theory and observed across two structured D&D sessions designed to surface real-world teamwork behaviors.  In one session, participants played characters aligned with their personality preferences; in the other, they played characters opposed to those preferences. Scenarios targeted specific team challenges such as communication, leadership, decision-making, and conflict resolution.  Team performance was evaluated using a tournament-style scoring model and participant surveys measuring key collaboration metrics. The seminar shares observed patterns, conclusions, and practical insights applicable to corporate teams, education, healthcare, and gaming groups.

events.title: Campaigns Of Connection: How TTRPGs impact Loneliness and Social Support in Adult Players
events.shortDescription: In this presentation, we discuss a research study conducted with over 200 TTRPG players about how their game characteristics affected feelings of loneliness and social support.
events.longDescription: Tabletop roleplaying games (TTRPGs) like Dungeons & Dragons are often discussed as social experiences, but little research has examined how they relate to social support and loneliness. This presentation summarizes findings from a quantitative study of 150+ U.S. adult TTRPG players across online, in-person, and hybrid groups. Results show a strong relationship between perceived social support and lower loneliness. Meeting frequency and emotional openness predicted higher social support, while play modality (online vs. in-person) did not significantly differ. Findings suggest that how groups interact matters more than where they play, highlighting TTRPGs as meaningful spaces for connection and community well-being.

events.title: Introduction to Kendo
events.shortDescription: Join the members of Gotokukan, an Indianapolis Kendo Dojo, to learn some of the basics of Kendo. This will be interactive and include actual drills.
events.longDescription: You will learn with the shinai (split bamboo sword) in hands-on instruction lead by the kenshi, including proper footwork, how to hold the shinai, and how to strike a target. Money raised will benefit Gotokukan Dojo, a non-profit kendo dojo in Indianapolis.

events.title: Tyranny of Dragons Chapter 1: Embers of Conspiracy
events.shortDescription: Rumors of secret gatherings and strange dragon symbols draw heroes into a growing threat beneath the surface.
events.longDescription: An eight-part epic where each mission stands alone yet shapes an unfolding struggle against draconic forces and hidden conspirators. This adventure unfolds across eight connected sessions held throughout the convention. Each chapter is a self-contained mission with a clear objective and resolution, while player outcomes influence the direction and stakes of later chapters. Victories, failures, alliances, and discoveries carry forward, gradually revealing a far-reaching plot tied to powerful dragon-aligned forces. Participants may join a single session or follow the full arc across multiple days. Returning players will see the evolving consequences of earlier events, while new heroes can step directly into the action without confusion. The eighth and final session serves as the campaign’s conclusion, where accumulated choices determine how the larger conflict is ultimately resolved.
events.dupKey: tyranny of dragons chapter 1 embers of conspiracy|cincinnati arsenal gaming

events.title: The Last Light of the Boglands

events.longDescription: Rumors spread of an undead horde rising from the Boglands, led by a necromantic force that grows stronger each night. Only one artifact can halt the tide: a massive swamp grown crystal known as the Heart of Stillwater, hidden deep within the bog. The crystal has awakened — and if the Nighthawks (locally famous adventurers) don’t retrieve it and deliver it to the ritual site before the horde reaches civilization, the entire region will fall. A local druid circle begs the adventurers for help. The relenless horde of undead are already on the move. This adventure uses 5th level pre-generated characters.

events.title: Punch Bowl Demo: Sneak Peek at the Fall 2026 Release
events.shortDescription: No one knows when the giant fruits started growing, but everyone agrees they make a legendary punch. Compete to make the best massive bowl of punch in this highly interactive and puzzly game!
events.longDescription: When life gives you giant fruits, make giant punch! Become the head of one of four factions—orange, lemon, grape, or strawberry—and lead a band of rollicking revelers to victory. Compete with the other factions to bring the most desired ingredients to three massive punch bowls before they serve. Fish out your opponents’ fruits, add droves of your own, and introduce special ingredients to tip the balance. When each punch is served, the winner adds some to their punch cup, along with coveted ice cubes for varying bonuses. This game is easy to learn, with beautiful watercolor artwork and deluxe components. It includes elements of area control, as well as a unique deck curation mechanic where players manage an ever-diminishing deck. Outmaneuver your opponents to win eternal glory and an overflowing cup of punch!

events.title: Star Trek: The Necropolis
events.shortDescription: Stardate 6872.2: The USS Ranger and Kenyon are currently orbiting Torvus IV to survey newly discovered ruins with the Ranger's crew running safety and security of the mission.
events.longDescription: Stardate 6872.2: The USS Ranger and the science vessel USS Kenyon are in orbit around Torvus IV to survey the newly discovered ruins of a long dead civilization. We have temporarily dubbed this civilization the “Torvans” and initial surveys suggest that they might have been on the brink of achieving warp flight before mysteriously going extinct. 	While the Kenyon crew continue to survey the surface ruins, the Ranger’s crew will be scouting a freshly discovered burial necropolis to remove any safety concerns for the archeological teams. The passages are quite deep and have hidden deposits of toxic gases. However, thus far the mission has continued to proceed smoothly and it is my sincere hope that it will continue to do so.
events.dupKey: star trek the necropolis|

events.title: Chains Beneath the Frozen Sky
events.shortDescription: During the Federation–Klingon War, Starfleet learns captured officers will soon be sent to Rura Penthe. Can your crew locate the Klingon camp and rescue them before they vanish into the Empire?
events.longDescription: Federation is locked in open war with the Klingon Empire. While patrolling near contested space, your crew intercepts intelligence: captured officers are being held at a temporary Klingon camp and will soon be transported to Rura Penthe. Once they arrive, rescue will be nearly impossible. Starfleet Command authorizes a covert mission—locate the Klingon holding facility, infiltrate the camp, and extract the prisoners before their transport departs. Success will require diplomacy, stealth, technical ingenuity, and courage behind enemy lines. Using the Star Trek Adventures 2nd Edition rules, players portray Starfleet officers serving aboard a Constitution-class starship during the era of The Original Series. Pregenerated characters are provided and no experience is required. Expect tense decisions, cinematic action, and classic Star Trek problem-solving.

events.title: Starship Horizons: Adventures: Flight of the Eagle
events.shortDescription: The training vessel ASC Eagle is on its final cruise and the crew must intervene to prevent an intergalactic war. Can you graduate from the Academy in one piece? Crews select Mission 1, 2, 3 or 4.
events.longDescription: The sci-fi adventure where your crew commands the bridge of a Starship! Outfit your vessel with upgrades provided by your Quartermaster to make your ship even stronger on one of multiple missions in a continuing storyline. Six roles await those valiant enough to board the bridge in this immersive experience featuring a fully interactive bridge set, touchscreens, expansive galactic setting, live NPCs and more. Select your role of Captain, Flight, Tactical, Operations, Sciences or Engineering Officer. At the start each player is issued a folio of 10 Ship Upgrades ($10 value), with even more Ship Upgrades awarded at the completion of their mission. They can also be used in future adventures to make your ship even stronger! If you are a fan of Artemis, Empty Epsilon or Star Trek: Bridge Crew this is the adventure for you.

Outfit your vessel with upgrades provided by your Quartermaster to make your ship even stronger on one of multiple missions in a continuing storyline. Six roles await those valiant enough to board the bridge in this immersive experience featuring a fully interactive bridge set, touchscreens, expansive galactic setting, live NPCs and more. Select your role of Captain, Flight, Tactical, Operations, Sciences or Engineering Officer. At the start each player is issued a folio of 10 Ship Upgrades ($10 value), with even more Ship Upgrades awarded at the completion of their mission. They can also be used in future adventures to make your ship even stronger! If you are a fan of Artemis, Empty Epsilon or Star Trek: Bridge Crew this is the adventure for you.

events.title: The Gang: Deluxe
events.shortDescription: Join in this co-operative version of Texas Hold'em, players bet on how good they think their hand of cards will be relative to the other players, then try to make their predictions a reality.
events.longDescription: Early in a round, without talking to each other, each player chooses a chip indicating how good they think their hand is. Then they begin dealing cards into the middle of the table and have a chance to reassess their hands as more cards are revealed. At the end of the round, players see whether they correctly evaluated their hand. If all players did, you get to open one of the bank vaults! If not, you trip the alarm! If you manage to open three vaults before you trip the alarm three times, your gang wins!
